summary_en: AreaLink Co., Ltd. completed tender offer for Storage-Oh Co., Ltd. (2997) on 8/21/2026. Tendered securities: 1,630,384 shares (ordinary stock and warrant instruments). Offer succeeded as tender volume (1,630,384 shares) exceeded minimum threshold (1,291,700 shares). Settlement commences 8/28/2026. AreaLink will hold >50% of voting rights post-settlement and become parent, principal shareholder, and lead shareholder. Prior principal shareholder K.L.I. Co., Ltd. tendered all holdings and will cease to qualify as related party.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Tender Offer for Shares and Warrant Instruments of Storage-Oh Co., Ltd. by AreaLink Co., Ltd., and Changes in Parent Company, Related Companies, Principal Shareholders, and Lead Shareholder
translation_en_brief: AreaLink Co., Ltd. completed a tender offer for Storage-Oh Co., Ltd. common shares and warrant instruments on 8 August 2026. The offer ran from 9 July 2026 to 21 August 2026. A total of 1,630,384 securities were tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 1,291,700 shares, so the offer succeeded. All tendered securities will be acquired by AreaLink. Settlement commences on 28 August 2026. Upon settlement, AreaLink will own more than 50% of Storage-Oh's voting rights and will become its parent company, principal shareholder, and lead shareholder. Prior principal shareholder K.L.I. Co., Ltd. tendered all of its Storage-Oh holdings and will no longer qualify as a related party or principal shareholder. The offer document does not disclose the tender price or total yen value. Storage-Oh and AreaLink had a pre-existing relationship: Storage-Oh retained AreaLink as a trustee for property management services.
